readme:
# My Hook

What fires it and what one transaction does.

## HookParameters

| Name | Type | Unit | What it sets |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FEE` | UInt64 (BE) | drops | The fee. |

## State

- **Record kind**: what one entry is, its key and its value.

Numbers are big-endian. Times are ledger time (seconds since 2000-01-01).

namespaces.0000000000000000000000000000000000000000: the seed string hashed into the namespace
